string.text: Wider New Game Loadout (purchases) panel. Optional defaults: Veteran difficulty + Survivalist economy, Invictus mode settings, and each faction's main base. You can still change them on the New Game screen.
New Game and Randomize pick Veteran difficulty and Survivalist economy. Manual combo changes still work.
New Game picks Story, Ironman (2 lives), Veteran, and Survivalist; Warfare, Azazel, and Soulslike off. Manual changes still work.
New Game and Randomize pick each faction's main base instead of Random. Factions without a mapped base (e.g. ISG) stay Random.
